bio: In the heart of Yverdon-les-Bains, the GERBER WYSS establishment is a fine dining eatery, a bakery-chocolaterie and a tearoom. The former’s distinctive style is founded on cryoconcentration, fermentation, fresh herbs and vegetables, in a bid to enhance Swiss produce. This virtuoso, veggie-centric technique is packed in emotion, precision and visual appeal. The eight-course Signature Menu immerses you in this universe with dishes such as poultry oyster meat, fermented shiitake water and Suchy hazelnuts. The terrace is perfect for an aperitif before dinner or snacks. A warm interior and stylish, slick service....
